name: VidWords YouTube
description: Search a YouTube video's transcript and read its frames — slides, charts, demos and on-screen text — with every answer citing a clickable timestamp.
author: VidWords

tools.name: search_transcript
tools.description: Search one YouTube video for a phrase or topic and return the matching moments with timestamps and deep links you can cite.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch the complete transcript text for one or more YouTube videos (up to 25 per call).

tools.name: list_channel_videos
tools.description: Resolve a YouTube channel handle, URL or id to its recent uploads.

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description: The account's Radar watchlists — the YouTube channels it monitors for new uploads.

tools.name: watchlist_activity
tools.description: The most recent videos Radar has recorded for one watchlist, newest first.

tools.name: account
tools.description: The plan and credit balance for the calling token, so an agent can price a batch before running it.

tools.name: analyze_video
tools.description: Start a deep visual analysis of a YouTube video: chapters, key moments, on-screen text and evidence tied to exact timestamps.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Fetch the analysis started by analyze_video once it is ready.

tools.name: ask_video
tools.description: Ask a question against a finished analysis and get an answer whose citations are verified against the stored evidence.
